verdict.rationale: The Titan Security Key is a passive FIDO hardware authenticator with no vendor software, CLI, SDK or API of its own, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any telemetry-bearing software surface that would make the story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
